contact_graph.method: Full semantic-part graph using actual vertex/triangle boundaries, enclosed points, edge/triangle and coplanar-edge intersections. AABB only rejects separated pairs; it never establishes contact.
contact_graph.limits: Geometric connectivity, not structural design, attachment strength, irrigation, load, or simulation behavior. Open folded foliage is not treated as a closed support hull.

limits: Soil-filled cavities are not visually empty. Tests exclude only soil medium and preserve actual retaining/floor geometry.
Standalone rear approach applies before adding the separately measured trailing plant. The final assembled strip must be tested independently.
Exact triangle/box intersection and convex feasibility prove stated inset boxes for these static components; finite rays are supplementary, not continuous actor fit.
All geometric support connectivity and seam witnesses are component-level only. No structural loads, host adoption, plant care or species claims.
